_comment: Cities this pipeline can bootstrap a crosswalk for. Drawn from the verified inventory in portals/. 'population' is REQUIRED for rate-based indicators and MUST cite a source -- an uncited denominator is how a rate becomes fiction, so it is null where we have not sourced one and the bootstrapper says so.

cities.name: New York City
cities.note: The reference implementation. 12 graded pairs in probe/crosswalk.json.

population.source: Padrón municipal, Ayuntamiento de Madrid — datos.madrid.es dataset 200076-0-padron
population.note: Municipality, not greater city. Eurostat urb_cpop1 reports 5,115,272 for 'Madrid (greater city)' against 3,520,396 here — using Eurostat would push every Madrid rate about 31% too low. Single snapshot: the historic series lives in dataset 209163-0-padron-municipal-historico and is not wired yet, so trend rates are not available.

cities.name: Milan
cities.note: Italian-language catalog. No sourced denominator yet.

cities.name: Buenos Aires
cities.note: Spanish-language catalog. The portal closes the connection on anonymous package_search (RemoteDisconnected), on two attempts a day apart. Recorded as unreachable rather than as zero results -- they are different findings.
